title: Cancellation Refund Terms of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs — Cancellation Refund Terms

Each pack size of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs fixes two refund terms for a client that cancels its program: the refund percentage, which is the share of the value of the unused purchased units refunded when the client cancels within the refund window, and the refund window itself, counted in calendar days after purchase.

| Pack | Refund percentage (of the value of unused purchased units) | Refund window (calendar days after purchase) |
|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 0 (no refund) | 0 (none given) |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 0 (no refund) | 0 (none given) |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 50 | 30 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 50 | 30 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 75 | 60 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 75 | 60 |

## Notes

1. A refund percentage of 0 means no refund, and a refund window of 0 means none is given; both apply to the First Notice 50-Unit Program and the First Notice 150-Unit Program.
2. The refund percentage applies to the value of **unused purchased units** only.
3. The First Notice 300-Unit and 600-Unit Programs pair a 50 percent refund with a 30-day window; the First Notice 1200-Unit and 2500-Unit Programs pair a 75 percent refund with a 60-day window.

## Hypothetical illustration

For a hypothetical value of unused purchased units of 1000.00 USD, a refund percentage of 50 gives 500.00 USD and a refund percentage of 75 gives 750.00 USD.
